## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Verification

List the commands and manual scenarios used to verify the change.

## Screenshots

Include screenshots for interface changes. Use only synthetic or fully redacted data.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changed by this pull request.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass locally.
- [ ] I updated operator or user documentation where needed.
- [ ] I considered authorization, tenant isolation, audit history, and data-retention effects.
- [ ] Database changes are forward-compatible and have a documented backup or rollback path.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, screenshots, and commits contain no credentials, tokens, real COIs, policy numbers, or personal data.
- [ ] Compliance language remains document-scoped and does not imply insurer-side policy verification.
